name: mcard
description: 电子名片系统：稳定二维码、一键保存、多端导航、实体名片版式下载、时段套餐

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix miniapp install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:miniapp
